items: Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Errors & Exceptions: PHP's error and exception system: throw, catch, and the engine's own failures.
Interfaces: A pure contract of method signatures with no implementation.
Properties & Methods: Class state held in properties, and behaviour implemented as methods.
Static & Constants: Members belonging to the class itself rather than to any one instance.
Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Data Mapper: A layer that moves objects to and from storage without the object knowing SQL.
Dynamic Properties: Creating properties by assignment instead of declaration; deprecated since PHP 8.

8273.title: Here, I add a __toString() version to a minimal Person class
8273.code:
<?php
class Person
{
    public function getName(): string
    {
        return "Bob";
    }

    public function getAge(): int
    {
        return 44;
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        $desc  = $this->getName() . " (age ";
        $desc .= $this->getAge() . ")"; return $desc;
    }
}
